title: Southern one-nighters were dances, not theaters
summary: Down South the dates were dances; theaters were rare.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Okay. When you were doin' all those one-nighters in the South, were they mostly dances? Is that what...?
That was a...You never, like, played a theater or anything in those times?
No. They didn't have no theaters down there.
We played...A long time ago we played a coupla theaters down through thataway...years ago.
